simple.meaning: עִי (ʻîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a ruin (as if overturned).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עִי (H5856) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 79:1, with occurrences in Psalms, Jeremiah, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עִי (H5856) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עִי (H5856) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עִי (ʻîy) / H5856 is traced through Psalms 79:1, Jeremiah 26:18, Micah 1:6, Micah 3:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
